decision: Require execution filtering and review of both generated solutions and tests. No sample admitted, including passing samples; provenance, independent correctness, exclusions and representative coverage remain open.

execution_contract.adapter: Execute unmodified supplied tests at module scope through the sandbox; all 16 have immediate top-level assertions. No dependency installation or test repair.
execution_contract.mutation: Replace all explicit return values with None; gross-bug smoke only, not mutation-coverage measurement. Only originally passing programs can establish rejection of a broken solution.

records.observation: Required empty construction calls update with no arguments, which raises TypeError. The generated tests begin with empty construction. The update implementation also indexes positional arguments inconsistently with a bound instance method.

A test asserts an all-bomb grid at t=5 while its own generated comment disputes that expectation and says to skip it; the assertion remains active. This is a concrete test-generation artifact, not a full diagnosis of every failing assertion.

failure_review.scope: Full task, solution and supplied-test inspection for two failed records only.

sampling: Same contiguous Python L3 window as code-preview.json; not a population estimate.
